_comment: Whole-grid 180-degree rotation (flip both axes). Third sibling of the dihedral family (flip_h.json, flip_v.json): same concept, the composed map (ih-1-r, iw-1-c). Solved by the Slow-path synthesizer schema 5 (make_grid(in_h,in_w,bg) + paint_remap('rot180')). Output dims equal input dims, so it lands in the same make_grid+paint_remap skeleton family; once flip_h and flip_v have lifted the map leaf to ?v with a trace, this task is simply absorbed into covers (covers 2 -> 3), demonstrating the lifted ?v map generalises across three distinct maps rather than a per-task literal.
